nodes.description: Public uint storing the deadline timestamp after which the last bidder wins.
Public uint holding the accumulated pot balance deposited by bidders.
Public uint fee divisor (10) used to compute the dev fee from msg.value.
Hardcoded developer address that receives the fee on every payable call.
Address of the most recent eligible bidder, the potential winner of the pot.
Payable constructor that initializes lastBidder, kBalance, timeOut and feeRate.
Payable fallback function handling bids, fee payment, timer extension and winner payout.
Caller-controlled address used as lastBidder and as the payable call origin.
Block timestamp (now) used both to set and to compare timeOut.
External .transfer(_fee) call sending the computed fee to the hardcoded developer address.
External .transfer(kBalance - _val) call to the caller-controlled lastBidder before state finalization.
Unchecked arithmetic: msg.value/feeRate, msg.value-_fee, kBalance+=_val, timeOut+=(10 minutes)*(9 finney)/_val.
Timestamp dependency: comparison timeOut <= now controls payout branch and is manipulable by miners.
Local variable holding msg.value / feeRate, the developer fee diverted on each call.
Local variable holding msg.value - _fee, the amount credited to the pot and used in the payout.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to lastBidder, letting the caller determine the stored winner address.
Untrusted msg.sender triggers execution of the payable fallback function.
timeOut is derived from block.timestamp, making the game deadline depend on miner-controlled time.
block.timestamp (now) is compared against timeOut to decide the payout branch.
Constructor sets timeOut = now + 10 minutes from the block timestamp.
Constructor initializes kBalance with the deployment msg.value.
Constructor sets the feeRate constant to 10.
Constructor sets lastBidder to msg.sender.
Fallback computes local _fee = msg.value / feeRate.
Fallback computes local _val = msg.value - _fee.
The computed fee _fee is passed to the external transfer to TechnicalRise.
_val influences the kBalance - _val amount sent via external transfer to lastBidder.
_val is used in the division (10 minutes)*(9 finney)/_val and kBalance arithmetic.
Fallback unconditionally executes the external transfer of the fee.
Fallback executes the external transfer to lastBidder inside the timeout branch.
External transfer to lastBidder can re-enter the payable fallback before kBalance is reset.
kBalance is read to compute the payout transferred to lastBidder.
kBalance += _val and kBalance = _val are unchecked state arithmetic.
Stored timeOut is compared with now in the win condition.
timeOut += 2 minutes and timeOut += (10 minutes)*(9 finney)/_val are unchecked arithmetic.
feeRate divides msg.value without rounding or zero-check protection.
TechnicalRise is the recipient address of the external fee transfer.
lastBidder, fully controlled by msg.sender, is the target of the payout transfer.
Fallback executes unchecked arithmetic on msg.value, kBalance and timeOut.
Fallback branches on the timestamp comparison timeOut <= now.
Fallback overwrites lastBidder with msg.sender at the end of a successful bid.

normalization_plan.reason: Local _fee is a transient result of the arithmetic expression msg.value / feeRate and should be folded into the arithmetic unsafe operation node.
Local _val only determines the payout amount sent by the external transfer to lastBidder and should be merged into that unsafe operation node.
